title: Massless contraction of massive particles in the infinite boost limit
summary: Massless particles, defined through Wigner's induced representations of the Poincaré group, are obtained as a limit of infinitely boosted massive particles wherein the massive little group undergoes an Inönü--Wigner contraction to the massless one. It is demonstrated that the spin-$s$ multiplet of a massive representation re-organizes into the direct sum of massless particles with helicities in the range $[-s,s]$.
